title: 24 September 2026 — Insurance Daily
description:

- Here’s where thousands of homeowners face higher insurance bills after FEMA updated its flood maps (MarketWatch)
- MultiPlan antitrust ruling raises questions for self-funded plans (Insurance Business America)
- State of Emergency Declared in California in Anticipation of More El Niño-driven Storms (Carrier Management)
- US Northeast Braces for Flooding as Coastal Storm Brews (Claims Journal)
- Despite State Law, Only 8 of 160 Texas Utilities Filed Wildfire Response Plans (Carrier Management)
- Benefits data moves to center of broker renewal talks (Insurance Business America)
- Brown & Brown courts CFOs with 2027 health costs climbing (Insurance Business America)
- Cyber Threats the Top Business Concern as AI Heightens Risk: Travelers Risk Index (Carrier Management)
